prompts.prompt: Illumio uses a four-dimensional label model to describe workloads instead of relying on IP addresses in policy. What are the four label dimensions? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/illumio/SKILL.md - Label-Based Policy Model table: Role, Application, Environment, Location

prompts.prompt: Illumio workloads can be placed into different enforcement modes to enable a gradual policy rollout. Name the mode meaning installed but not enforcing, the mode enforcing only known rules while allowing the rest, the mode that fully blocks non-permitted traffic, and the validation-only mode that logs what would be blocked. Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/illumio/SKILL.md - Enforcement Modes table: Idle, Visibility Only, Selective, Full, Test

prompts.prompt: The Illumio VEN agent enforces policy by managing the workload native OS firewall. What underlying mechanism does it manage on Linux, and what does it manage on Windows? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/illumio/SKILL.md - VEN Agent Management: Linux manages iptables (or nftables), Windows manages Windows Filtering Platform (WFP)
